facts.text: The hotel is housed in COMO Orchard on Bideford Road.
facts.excerpt: Housed in COMO Orchard on Bideford Road, COMO Metropolitan Singapore marks many firsts.

facts.text: The hotel is linked to Paragon Shopping Centre via a covered walkway.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is linked to Paragon Shopping Centre via a covered walkway and sits inside COMO Orchard, home to Club 21 retail.

facts.text: The hotel is located in the heart of the Orchard Road district.
facts.excerpt: COMO Metropolitan Singapore is located at 30 Bideford Road, in the heart of the Orchard Road district.

facts.text: The hotel marks COMO's debut in its home country.
facts.excerpt: COMO Metropolitan Singapore, housed in COMO Orchard on Bideford Road, marks a debut in our home country.

facts.text: The hotel is part of an integrated experience spread over 19 floors at COMO Orchard, combining hospitality, fashion, wellness and cuisine.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is part of an integrated, immersive experience spread over 19 floors, bringing the best of COMO Group's hospitality, fashion, wellness and cuisine into one inspiring location in the heart of Singapore.

facts.text: The interiors were created by Atelier Ikebuchi and Milan-based OTTO Studio headed by Paola Navone, with Norwegian digital artist Thomas Hilland and New York firm Modellus Novus.
facts.excerpt: brought to life by longtime COMO design partners Atelier Ikebuchi and Milan-based OTTO Studio headed up by Paola Navone, along with Norwegian digital artist Thomas Hilland and Modellus Novus, a New York City-based architecture firm.

facts.text: The design is defined by modern simplicity and a pale colour palette.
facts.excerpt: each space confident in its modern simplicity, pale colour palette, and attention to detail.

facts.text: Every room and suite is equipped with SleepHub, a neuroscience-led device designed to help guests achieve deeper, more restorative rest.
facts.excerpt: all equipped with SleepHub®, an innovative, neuroscience-led solution designed to help modern travellers achieve deeper, more restorative rest.

facts.text: Rooms feature clean-lined, customised furnishings from Giorgetti.
facts.excerpt: Our spaces feature clean-lined, customised furnishings from Giorgetti, integrated with tech-forward touches for your comfort and convenience.

facts.text: Rooms include a discreet kitchenette and an in-room card-protected delivery vault.
facts.excerpt: from a discreet kitchenette to an in-room card-protected delivery vault for services that you order to your room.

facts.text: Cairnhill Rooms have wall-to-wall windows with a city view.
facts.excerpt: Admire the city view through wall-to-wall windows while you unwind in your own private, light-filled room designed for rest and work.

facts.text: The COMO Suite is a two-bedroom suite with a generous living and dining area and en suite bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: This two-bedroom suite feels like a home away from home: it includes a generous living and dining area, as well as en suite bathrooms.

facts.text: The hotel has a rooftop infinity pool with elevated views over Orchard Road.
facts.excerpt: COMO Metropolitan Singapore features a rooftop infinity pool that offers elevated views over Orchard Road.

facts.text: COMO Shambhala Singapore, the wellness brand's urban flagship, occupies a 9,000-square-foot space on the fourth floor of COMO Orchard.
facts.excerpt: COMO Shambhala Singapore, the global wellness brand's urban flagship, occupies the literal and metaphorical ‘heart' of COMO Orchard: a fourth-floor, 9,000-sq ft haven for nurturing wellness from within.

facts.text: The COMO Shambhala space was designed by Paola Navone of OTTO Studio to reflect the flow and palette of healing water.
facts.excerpt: a calm, contemporary space designed by Milan-based designer and architect, Paola Navone of OTTO Studio, to reflect the flow and palette of healing water.

facts.text: The thermal suites include a Red Light Therapy Room, Contrast Therapy Rooms and an Oxygen Therapy Space.
facts.excerpt: Featuring a Red Light Therapy Room, Contrast Therapy Rooms and Oxygen Therapy Space.

facts.text: The fitness gym has over 20 types of strength and functional training equipment, including Eleiko weightlifting equipment.
facts.excerpt: Outfitted with over 20 types of strength and functional training equipment including Eleiko weightlifting equipment

facts.text: COMO Shambhala's approach integrates gut health and body composition diagnostics with functional fitness training, yoga, Pilates, hot and cold therapies and hands-on healing.
facts.excerpt: The expert-led approach integrates gut health and body composition diagnostics, with functional fitness training, yoga, Pilates, hot and cold therapies and hands-on healing.

facts.text: The hotel offers four-day, three-night cleanse menus from COMO Shambhala Kitchen.
facts.excerpt: Embark on a complete digestive reset with the new four-day, three-night cleanse menus from COMO Shambhala Kitchen.

facts.text: Guests can try on fashion in their own room with a Club 21 personal stylist.
facts.excerpt: Try on the latest in fashion at your convenience with the guidance of your very own Club 21 personal stylist.

facts.text: Club 21 in the building carries brands including Alaïa, Amiri, Marine Serre, Simone Rocha, Thom Browne and Tom Wood, each in dedicated spaces.
facts.excerpt: Lovers of fashion can shop from a diverse line-up of brands that includes Alaïa, Amiri, Marine Serre, Simone Rocha, Thom Browne and Tom Wood, each showcased in dedicated spaces.

facts.text: The Club 21 store was designed by Paola Navone, a light-filled space with a 7-metre-high ceiling.
facts.excerpt: Designed by acclaimed award-winning Italian architect Paola Navone, the light-filled space with 7m-high ceiling beautifully showcases the best of international fashion

facts.text: Cédric Grolet brings his signature pastries to his first patisserie in Asia at COMO Orchard.
facts.excerpt: We celebrate another first with Cédric Grolet who brings his signature pastries to his first patisserie in Asia.

facts.text: COMO Orchard is home to COTE Singapore, a Korean steakhouse from Simon Kim.
facts.excerpt: COMO Orchard is home to COTE Singapore, a Korean Steakhouse from Simon Kim

facts.text: COTE Singapore is a Michelin-starred Korean barbecue experience.
facts.excerpt: Michelin-starred Korean barbecue experience.

facts.text: The rooftop pool bar lets guests take in the sights of the city below.
facts.excerpt: Whether you prefer lounging by the pool or relaxing inside, our rooftop pool bar is a place to unwind as you take in the sights of the city below.

facts.text: The Lobby Lounge serves artisan coffee brewed by a robot barista named Bruno.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy artisan coffee brewed by our robot barista, Bruno.

facts.text: Rooms come with an in-room yoga mat and meditation videos on the TV.
facts.excerpt: In-room yoga mat with meditation videos on TV

facts.text: The hotel is a 25-minute drive from Changi Airport.
facts.excerpt: COMO Metropolitan Singapore is a 25-minute drive from Changi Airport.

facts.text: Singapore has no distinct wet or dry season, but higher rainfall typically occurs from November to January.
facts.excerpt: While there is no distinct wet or dry season in Singapore, higher rainfall typically occurs from November to January.

facts.text: Extra beds and baby cots can be arranged on request.
facts.excerpt: Extra beds and baby cots can be arranged upon request

facts.text: The hotel calls itself one of the finest wellness-focused luxury hotels in Asia.
facts.excerpt: COMO Metropolitan Singapore is one of the finest wellness-focused luxury hotels in Asia

facts.text: The wellness centre has movement studios for yoga and Pilates.
facts.excerpt: A gym, two Pilates studios and two yoga studios

facts.text: The wellness facilities include a Pilates studio with Balanced Body equipment.
facts.excerpt: a Pilates studio with Balanced Body equipment

contradictions.note: p4 says two Pilates studios, p5 says a Pilates studio
